Name: Frontier Farm Better Bridges
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
Replaces Frontier Farm's two small wooden plank bridges with sturdier styles for anyone who just wants the [b]rickety little[/b] bridges on their farm to look more stable!

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]

[b][size=3]✧ What's included[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Independently replace the appearance of the horizontal and vertical bridges on Frontier Farm.[/*]
[*]Timber and Planks styles for each bridge (or leave Default for the original plank look)[/*]
[*]Bridge finish options: Light Brown, Dark Brown, and Weathered[/*]
[*]Optional recolor for Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, Earthy Interiors, and Starblue Valley (via Sharogg's Tilesheets config)[/*]
[*]This mod does not effect any maps other than Frontier Farm.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.8.1+ (Mobile Friendly)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files&version_history=135999]Frontier Farm[/url] installed, on a save using that farm type[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27117]Sharogg's Tilesheets[/url] [/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]✧ Configuration[/size][/b]
Open GMCM (Gear button on the title menu, or Mod Options at the bottom of in-game settings) and find [b]Frontier Farm Better Bridges[/b].
[list]
[*]Horizontal Bridge Style: Default, Timber, or Planks[/*]
[*]Vertical Bridge Style: Default, Timber, or Planks[/*]
[*]Bridge Finish: Light Brown, Dark Brown, or Weathered.[/*]
[/list]Recolor variations are adjustable in Sharogg's Tilesheets configuration.
